page: Microsoft Azure E48ads_v6 is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the Eadv6 family. It is powered by a dedicated AMD EPYC 9V74 processor running at 3.7 GHz, featuring 24 physical cores and 48 vCPUs with hyper-threading enabled. The hardware configuration includes 384.0 GB of system memory, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Storage is bundled with a 2835 GB local NVMe SSD, and the instance is Premium Storage capable. No GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included.

Benchmark data indicates strong performance across multiple domains. The server achieves top 25% results in stress-ng single-core and multi-core CPU tests, as well as Geekbench single-core and multi-core evaluations. Memory performance is highlighted by a strong read-only small block bandwidth of 3648.86 GB/sec, though large block read and write bandwidths fall into the average range. Database operations and Redis SET operations perform in the top 25%, with Redis reaching 67.13 million operations per second.

For specialized workloads, the server demonstrates strong capabilities in software compilation, ray tracing, and small-model LLM inference. However, performance drops to average for medium-model LLM inference and is weak for large-model LLM text generation. Given the 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio and high-speed local NVMe SSD, this server is optimized for memory-intensive applications, database hosting, and data processing tasks rather than large-scale AI model execution.
description: The Microsoft Azure E48ads_v6 is a memory-optimized server from the Eadv6 family, powered by a dedicated 3.7 GHz AMD EPYC 9V74 processor with 48 vCPUs and 24 physical cores. It features 384.0 GB of RAM, establishing an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio, and includes a 2835 GB local NVMe SSD. Benchmarks show strong performance in CPU-bound tasks, database operations, and small-model LLM inference, while large-model text generation remains a performance bottleneck. This hardware profile is highly suited for memory-intensive workloads, database management, and data processing. It offers a balanced resource density for enterprise applications requiring high memory capacity and fast local storage without the need for dedicated GPU acceleration. The server also demonstrates strong multi-threaded decompression and software compilation capabilities.
